name: Should kitchen baseboards match the cabinets or the rest of the house?

mainEntity.name: Should kitchen baseboards match the cabinets or the rest of the house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Baseboards match either the kitchen cabinets or the surrounding architectural room trim, depending on your layout. In open-concept kitchens, matching the baseboards to the adjacent living room trim creates visual flow and makes the entire floor feel connected. However, the cabinet toe-kick molding should match the cabinet finish directly. If you have contrasting kitchen island cabinets, wrapping the island base in matching island trim gives it a freestanding furniture appearance while perimeter walls can match standard home trim.
acceptedAnswer.description: Toe-kicks should match your cabinets, while perimeter wall baseboards usually match the rest of your home trim to keep an open-concept flow.
